integrity: The identities follow from the explicit vector field, invariant logarithmic averages, and exact linear algebra. Symbolic replay verifies algebra only.
scientific_limitations: The invariant-measure statement assumes compact support inside the open cube. It is not asserted for boundary-accumulating SRB measures without additional logarithmic integrability and zero-log-drift results. No new recurrent-state existence theorem is claimed.
title: Exact forcing-induced mean skew in the periodically forced May–Leonard system
